name: qjs_get_exception

ownership.argument: Aligned by the order+size+body method against .155 and then confirmed by the exception-slot invariant; it also sits immediately after the internal __JS_FreeValue, as in source order.

provenance.source: Body is identical to the .155 binding at 0xc3b793e: read the runtime pointer from ctx+16, return the exception slot *(u64*)(rt+128) and store JS_UNDEFINED (0x200000000) into it. Size 26 here versus 20 on .155 — same three operations, no extra work.

notes: Aligned by the order+size+body method against .155 and then confirmed by the exception-slot invariant; it also sits immediately after the internal __JS_FreeValue, as in source order.
